messages:
Claire Nguyen: Quick UX spike: users keep misreading priority badges when rules are dense. Proposals: 1) show numeric index in left gutter (1..N) that updates live, 2) convert tiny dot badges to labeled pills (P1/P2) with icon, 3) collapse low-priority tail into a "+N rules" summary. Which feels least disruptive?

Omar Rahman: Gutter index wins for quick scanning. Pills help but clutter. Summary row ok if accessible (aria-expanded + descriptive label). Keep DOM order stable when collapsing.

Jenny Park: Accessibility: make the index a focusable element with tooltip "Rule position {i} of {total}" and aria-describedby. For collapse button use aria-expanded and announce via aria-live: "Expanded 5 hidden rules" / "Collapsed 5 hidden rules".

Luis Ortega: Small but important: when reordering, provide an undo toast: "Moved "Add header" to position 2. [Undo]". Undo should call the revert endpoint and announce: "Change undone: rule moved back to position 4". Also add keyboard-only move actions (move to top/bottom).

ux-ci-bot: Layout checks: 8% chance of validation helper overlapping preview toggle at <=360px. Suggest switching inline helper (pushes content) instead of absolute overlay.

Claire Nguyen: Action items: Omar - add gutter index comps + toggle for pills; Jenny - draft aria strings & aria-live messages; Luis - stub undo toast + history link. We'll review Friday morning. Thanks! :raised_hands:
